name: Disable Sticky Keys
description: Disables Sticky Keys and its five-Shift shortcut to prevent accidental activation during normal use or gaming.

description_i18n.en: Disables Sticky Keys and its five-Shift shortcut to prevent accidental activation during normal use or gaming.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Sticky Keys und die Aktivierung durch fünfmaliges Drücken der Umschalttaste, um versehentliche Aktivierungen zu verhindern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les touches rémanentes et leur raccourci par cinq pressions sur Maj afin d'éviter une activation accidentelle.

warnings.title: Accessibility setting
warnings.message: Sticky Keys and its keyboard shortcut remain unavailable until the tweak is restored.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses the documented Windows SystemParametersInfo API to turn off Sticky Keys and the five-Shift activation shortcut while preserving unrelated accessibility flags. Restoring re-enables the shortcut without turning Sticky Keys on.
